caseStudies.title: Electrode Tab Ultrasonic Final Weld Mark Quality Inspection
caseStudies.description: Inspects ultrasonic weld marks on transition tabs and flexible connectors to ensure weld quality, detecting tab burrs, folding, tearing, and weld-mark misalignment.

caseStudies.title: Cylindrical Battery Exterior Surface Inspection
caseStudies.description: A CorteX-only vision solution for cylindrical battery exteriors, detecting contamination, scratches, impact marks, and pits while integrating with existing equipment and MES systems.

caseStudies.title: Battery Top-Cap Surface Inspection
caseStudies.description: Detects over 100 defect types on reflective battery top covers—including weld breaks, voids, oxidation, scratches, and membrane misalignment—while reducing labor costs across diverse materials and sizes.

caseStudies.title: Automotive Electric Stators Surface Inspection
caseStudies.description: An AI-driven vision system delivers complete coverage and real-time traceability for electric stators, detecting missing welds, enamel damage, 2-ball, burrs, scratches, and core delamination.
caseStudies.keyMetric: 100% detection accuracy across all 8 defect types during validation

caseStudies.title: Automotive Gear Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: Automated inspection catches gear defects—sand holes, scratches, and rust—before they cause safety issues, rework, or OEM quality failures.

caseStudies.title: Engine Case Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: A robot-assisted AI vision system scans engine cases from multiple angles, catching burrs, dents, flash, peeling, scratches, gas porosity, and 8+ other defects.
caseStudies.keyMetric: False Acceptance Rate ≤ 0.5%, False Rejection Rate ≤ 2%

caseStudies.title: Transmission Motor Shaft Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: A 6-axis robot with a 12MP OptiX station performs a high-speed rotation scan for total surface coverage, detecting rust, contamination, oil stains, dents, and 10+ more defects.

caseStudies.title: Rubber Bushing Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: A vertical-view configuration automates inspection of rubber surfaces and metal end-faces, detecting adhesion, indentation, cracks, missing sequence, and foreign objects in holes.

caseStudies.title: PCBA Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: A single AI model detects all defect types across five PCBA variants, including foreign particles, adhesive residue, fingerprints, and 10+ others.

caseStudies.title: CPU PIN Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: Automated inspection catches bent pins and foreign material on CPU pins early, reducing rework and improving production efficiency.

caseStudies.title: Rigid-Flex PCB Solder Joint Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: An upgraded AOI system supports rapid model changeovers while catching lifted joints, missing solder, solder bridges, and insufficient or excessive solder.

caseStudies.title: Photovoltaic Connector Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: An inline AI vision system inspects pin faces and cylindrical surfaces for indentations, cracks, scorching, imprints, contamination, and whitening, flagging yield drops in real time.
caseStudies.keyMetric: Triggers an alarm when consecutive defects exceed 3 pieces or yield drops below 95%

caseStudies.title: Terminal Connectors Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: Detects critical connector defects—flash, broken tool marks, and nonfill—that cause electrical failures, short circuits, and customer rejections.

caseStudies.title: Connector Pin Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: Four OptiX units perform five-face inspection plus precision dimensional measurement, detecting scratches, flattening, dents, and 10+ other defect types.

caseStudies.title: Dental Crowns Surface Defect Inspection
caseStudies.description: Ensures consistent end-of-line and glaze-station quality by detecting fractures, bubbles, missing glaze, white marks, pooling, and contamination on dental crowns.
